version_series_meaning: This package is a data-only overlay, and model_card_version names this overlay's own artifacts. The model graph its rows decode through is the one base_weights names, at that package's own model_card_version. Neither number is package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release.

inherited_lineage.note: These entries are @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's record of what its model graph was trained on. This package ships no graph and contributed none of these rows. Read them as the base's lineage rather than as a claim about this package's own artifacts, which are listed under artifacts and attributed under training_attribution.

attribution.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): the `osm-ru`, `osm-in`, `osm-id`, `osm-ng`, `osm-pk`, `osm-vn` and `osm-bd` training extracts taken from the 2026-10-02 Geofabrik extracts (2,282,782 rows in corpus v0.7.1-osm-exposure), plus the `rendered-pk-register` and `rendered-bd-register` training extracts rendered from OSM tuples. The v7.2.0 epoch audit emits 103,322 of 1,000,000 rows from the seven `osm-*` sources and 15,609 from the two registers. The `spliced-sub-venue` training extract also carries OpenStreetMap venue and sub-venue names, taken from the 2026-08 Geofabrik extracts of Great Britain, France, Germany and Spain, in 73,039 of its 120,000 rows; the epoch audit emits 52,806 rows from that source. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. The extracts are Derivative Databases under ODbL 1.0 and the effective training manifest packages/corpus/data/training-manifests/v0.7.2-address-systems.effective.json records what reached the trainer. The extracts are published under ODbL 1.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sister-software/mailwoman-osm-training-extract.

HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data address fields, held under no license that permits this use: this model was trained on the `synth-gb-v1` training extract, recorded as `rendered-gb` with 800,000 rows in corpus v0.7.2-address-systems, which the GB locale recipe renders from the Postcode, PAON, Street, Locality, Town/City and District fields of Price Paid Data. HM Land Registry's download page grants the Open Government Licence v3.0 for Price Paid Data but excludes those address fields, which Royal Mail and Ordnance Survey permit only for personal or non-commercial use and for displaying residential property price information. `packages/corpus/data/license-decisions.json` records the source as refused under `unchecked-access-free-gb-gb-property-building-1`. Earlier versions of this card credited these rows under OGL v3.0, and that credit was wrong. Removing the rows from the corpus and retraining is tracked in sister-software/mailwoman#2635. The GB placetype-pair index no longer reads this source.
LINZ-derived OpenAddresses NZ (CC-BY 4.0): the `synth-nz-v2` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0.
OpenAddresses ES tuples (CC-BY per OA source): the `synth-es-pedania-v1` training extract (800,000 rows, below-municipio pedanía place names) NEW in 6.7.0.

BAN — Base Adresse Nationale (DINUM / IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0): the `synth-fr-lieudit-v1` training extract (`nom_ld` lieu-dit field) NEW in 6.7.0, additional to the existing `synth-fr-fragment` extract (144,865 rows, 6.4.0).

Overture Maps Foundation — Addresses theme (per-country register license; Overture declares no identifier of its own for this theme, so the terms are the upstream register's): the `overture-latam` CA/MX training extract (456,230 rows, 6.6.0). Attribution-only, not share-alike. Read 2026-09-25 from https://docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/.
OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-cz coord eval sets
OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source): oa-sk coord eval set (free-rider validation)
OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source): oa-si coord eval set (free-rider validation)
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

entries.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): this overlay decodes through the `@mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us` model graph, which trained on OpenStreetMap-derived training extracts that package's card and effective training manifest record. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.

unresolved: No digest is recorded for 5 of 5 declared artifacts: fst-street-morphology.bin, anchor-lexicon-v1.json, locality-surface-lexicon-v7.json, street-type-lexicon-v3.json, country-surface-lexicon-v1.json. An unrecorded digest is not a verified one.
This package's model card attributes only the OpenStreetMap data behind @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's graph. It ships 5 artifacts and no model graph, so its own inputs are unattributed here.

Which records trained the model this package ships or inherits is unresolved. `buildCorpus` writes a frozen `TRAINING_SOURCES.json` naming every source that contributed and under which terms, `effective-manifest.run.ts` derives from it and an `audit_epoch_mixture` output what one config's epoch drew, and no released model was built from a corpus carrying either. The corpus named above is the recipe's corpus rather than a record of what reached the model.
